lender_name.description: Name of the auto finance company issuing the statement.

statement_date.description: Statement date printed in the page header, as YYYY-MM-DD.

account_number.description: Loan account number as printed in the account details, digits only.

borrower_name.description: Name of the borrower in the coupon's mailing address.

vehicle.description: The financed vehicle named at the top of the statement.

make_model.description: Make, model and trim as printed, e.g. GMC ACADIA DENALI.

total_amount_due.description: Total amount due shown in the statement header, in dollars.

due_date.description: Due date shown beside the total amount due in the statement header, as YYYY-MM-DD.

account_opened_date.description: Date the loan account was opened, as YYYY-MM-DD.

current_principal_balance.description: Current principal balance, in dollars. Not the payoff amount.

current_due.description: Each row of the Current Due section of the transaction summary, excluding the Total Current Due row.

date.description: Date of the row, as YYYY-MM-DD.

total_current_due.description: Total Current Due from the transaction summary, in dollars.

payments_received.description: Each payment listed under Payments Received in the transaction summary on the first page.

date.description: Date the payment was received, as YYYY-MM-DD.

payment_allocation.description: Each payment in the Transaction Details table on the reverse side, with how it was split between principal and interest.

date.description: Date of the payment, as YYYY-MM-DD, as printed in this table.

principal.description: Portion applied to principal, in dollars.

interest.description: Portion applied to interest, in dollars.

dealer_name.description: Name of the dealer under Your Dealer, as printed.
